working_tree: Uncommitted experimental source; tested surfaces identified by hashes
implemented: Version 2 compact fee counter and individually encrypted attempt records replace the original 16-element inline array
Caller-selected attempt budgets support 1 through 65536; new entry allocation is bounded across the wallet and existing declared fee budgets never reset
Authenticated original inline journals migrate atomically, preserving signatures, ordering, accepted limits, reserved fees and wallet identity
Native rows bind their relayer bank and sequence through scoped authenticated encryption; records validate signature, sender, pool, fee and exact parameter digest
Indexed entry counts reject missing metadata with retained attempts and missing attempt rows, preventing accidental budget recreation
Historical native_attempt lookup recovers a prior signed envelope without allocating another fee or nonce, including after wallet reopen
Signing and broadcasting explicitly reject prepared proofs whose notes/spent roots or count no longer match the authenticated current pool
One unconsumed live attempt prevents different operations or rebased parameters on the same relayer; exact retries retain the existing signed transaction
Expired attempts require another canonical head before replacement; reservations for prior attempts remain counted and the native nonce is reused only while unconsumed

tests.scope: The complete 241-test suite passed against the final production implementation. The canonical test was then expanded with direct stale-broadcast/rebase negative controls and rerun; do not add the overlapping test counts.

canonical_flow.scope: Actual local native intake and signed BFT canonical execution, not a public-network or funded tunnel qualification.

expiry_fixture.method: Test-only reconstruction of a valid native envelope with its timestamp 301 seconds earlier, re-signed by the same fixed local key.

limits: Explicit original attempt limits remain honored after migration; removing the prototype hard ceiling does not silently increase existing accepted budgets
New allocations stop at 65536 stored attempt records across a wallet; archival/compaction and explicit budget rollover remain future work
Deletion of an entire authenticated history or privileged rollback of all wallet state still needs an external high-water mark; row-count checks are not a general rollback proof
A live native signature retains its nonce even if its private proof becomes stale; replacement still requires nonce consumption or timestamp expiry plus another head
Operator-income custody handoff, multiple operator payer views, automatic routed-client scheduling/recovery and broader native host adapters remain unfinished
Public onboarding abuse controls, private service-equivocation claims, zero-price grants and key backup tooling remain unfinished
Production circuit ceremony/cryptographic review and actual funded private kernel/multi-node/ExEx qualification remain required
Released shielded_required stays refused; no full node parity, public deployment or physical delivery claim follows from these tests
No new formal theorem is claimed for this Rust journal change; pool AML and cryptographic sources are unchanged
next_gate: Integrate canonical operator-income custody and multiple operator payer views, then a funded private routed client with encrypted recovery, no-bypass kernel checks and ExEx qualification
